resumen: Standing side-on to a low pulley with the ankle attached, you move the leg out away from the body and return slowly. It works the gluteus medius with adjustable load.
ejecucion: Attach an ankle strap to the cable of a low pulley and put it on the ankle further from the pulley.
Stand side-on to the pulley and hold the machine with one hand, torso upright.
Move the leg out to the side, straight and toes forward, only as far as your pelvis stays level (a hand or two), without leaning your torso the other way.
Return slowly until your foot is next to the other, without letting the weight snap back.
If you have to lean or rotate the leg to lift it, lower the weight.
matices: We have found no study measuring standing cable abduction itself. The measured version is the side-lying one, which in a study of twenty-one people activated the gluteus medius most of twelve exercises. The cable does a similar movement standing and lets you add load, but we do not know whether it activates the gluteus medius equally.
